Download Link(information for full category)
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ppSdjmjh8dOF2qS8WKJnOgfwSQmfWPm3?usp=drive_link
Must-Know
1, 2.5G Ethernet port(10/100/1000M auto-adaptive), 10G Ethernet port(10/100/1000M/2.5G/5G auto-adaptive)
Please pay attention to the remark about FIBER PORT SPEED INFORMATION
2, The power comes in AC and DC input. For AC type, it has internal AC-DC converter
3.Power adapter is included in the price
But optical module is NOT included, need to purchase individually
For AC input models, there is a pair of mounting hangers in the packing box for rack mounting
4, Some models are having a fan inside, the noise is relatively acceptable by the feedback from many clients
